tasks.short: Check dimensions and number the materials.

steps.what: Compare stated dimensions with the model dimensions.
Check dimensions of materials and assign numbers to the lists.
Record the materials list the drafter accepted.

tasks.design: Where both the list and the drawing model in {OTHER} have a dimension id, the two figures are compared. The drafter checks the dimensions of materials to be used and assigns numbers to the lists. A material with no model dimension is not marked correct. The numbering follows the drafter, not the compare.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dimensions were checked with a scale on a print, and numbers were reused from the last list.
tasks.enabler_now: Two stored dimensions can be compared before the drafter looks at the exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: A dimension that is not in the model, and a number that would collide with a released list.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see two equal numbers that measure different things.

ambition.what: A material whose list dimension disagrees with the model is shown the day both figures exist, and the drafter still assigns the number.

tasks.altitude: Disagreements can be listed. The check and the numbering stay with the drafter. A missing dimension is not a pass.

reach.task: Expect a materials number to mean the dimension was checked.
reach.learn: The compare can list a clash. The acceptance is still here.

evidence.claim: Two stored dimensions can be compared. The compare cannot check a dimension the model does not hold.
Assigning a materials number is the drafter's act. A missing dimension stops the mark rather than passing the line.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Material id and dimension id, produced by the list and the model. A material with no dimension id is not compared. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the model and the list the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Who may release a numbered list.
Which dimension is the authority when they disagree.
research_questions: What share of materials have a model dimension?
How often do equal numbers measure different edges?

already_counted.description: The drafter still checks dimensions and assigns numbers.
The drafter still accepts the list.

incremental.description: The drafter measures a dimension the model did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the compare where both dimensions exist. It disappears when the model has no dimension and the drafter measures. The check remains, so the net stays under the prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Calculate weights and volumes from quantities and densities.
Judge the stress factors and their implications for the designs.
Record the technical result the drafter accepts.

tasks.design: Weights and volumes are calculated in {OTHER} only where quantity and density are both in the file. The drafter judges the stress factors and their implications for the technical aspects of the designs. A missing density stops the line. The calculation does not certify the design, and the engineer still owns the stress conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Weights were figured on a pad and typed again, and a density from another material was reused.
tasks.enabler_now: Quantity times density can be computed when both ids exist.
tasks.still_hard: A stress implication the arithmetic does not settle, and a density the file does not hold.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a correct weight on a member the design cannot carry.
tasks.altitude: Known weights can be computed. Stress and the design implication stay with the drafter. Nothing is certified.

reach.task: Own the stress conclusion the weight table only feeds.
reach.learn: The arithmetic can be prepared. The implication is still judged here and signed there.

evidence.claim: Weight and volume can be computed from a quantity and a density in the file. Stress implications cannot.
A missing density stops the line. The result is not a certification. The engineer signs the stress conclusion outside this task.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Element id, quantity, and density id, produced by the model. An element with no density id is not calculated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the densities the practice already stores.
research_questions: What share of elements have a density id?
Which implications are always referred to the engineer?

already_counted.description: The drafter still judges stress and implications.
The drafter still records the result.

incremental.description: The drafter looks up a density the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the weight and volume where density is already stored. It disappears when density is missing and the drafter calculates by hand. The stress judgement remains, so the net stays under the prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Locate and identify symbols for formations and installations.
Record the geological or oil-field reading.

tasks.design: The topographical survey is opened from {DOCS}. The drafter locates and identifies the symbols that denote geological and geophysical formations or oil field installations. The screen does not name a symbol. A reading is not a permit and not a tax decision. An unclear symbol stays unidentified.
tasks.previous_blocker: Symbol legends differed by survey firm, and identification was a pencil note that was later typed wrong.
tasks.enabler_now: The sheet can be the one opened. The reading is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A symbol the legend does not define, and a formation that needs the geologist.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can tell a similar mark from the symbol the legend actually defines.
tasks.altitude: The sheet is open. Identifying symbols stays with the drafter. No formation is decided by the screen.

reach.task: Draw the survey whose symbols the drafter reads.
reach.learn: The sheet can be opened. The identification cannot.

evidence.claim: A survey sheet can be opened. It cannot identify a symbol.
A map or a symbol reading does not decide a permit or a tax. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Survey id, produced by the survey file. A sheet with no id is not treated as read. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the survey file the practice already keeps. No new tool names symbols.
research_questions: Are legends filed with the survey?
What share of symbols are nonstandard?

already_counted.description: The drafter still identifies the symbols.
The drafter still records the reading.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a legend the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the sheet. It disappears when the survey is not filed and the drafter hunts the print. The reading time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the plans that are to be reproduced.
Reproduce the drawings on the copy machine or trace them.
Check the trace against the original plans.

tasks.design: The plans to be copied are listed from {DOCS}. The drafter reproduces the drawings on the copy machine or traces them on transparent paper or cloth with ink, pencil, and drafting instruments. The list does not run the machine and does not trace. A plan not on the list is not assumed copied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Copies were made from whichever print was on the table, and a trace was not checked back to the original.
tasks.enabler_now: The plans to copy can be listed. The copying and the tracing are unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A faint original, a machine jam, and a trace that drifts off the line.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a copy that is complete and a line that moved.
tasks.altitude: The list can be ready. Reproduction and tracing stay with the drafter. A copy is not an issue.

reach.task: Expect a trace that still matches the original plan.
reach.learn: The list can name the sheet. The trace is still made here.

evidence.claim: A list can name plans to copy. It cannot reproduce or trace them.
Operating the copy machine and tracing with instruments are the drafter's work. The machine's run is not labour that has already disappeared.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Plan id, produced by the plan set. A set with no plan id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the plan set the practice already keeps. No new tool traces the sheet.
unknowns: Which sheets must be traced rather than copied.
Who checks a trace before it is used.
research_questions: What share of reproduction is still a hand trace?
How often does a copy get used as if it were issued?

already_counted.description: The drafter still copies or traces.
The drafter still checks the trace.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a plan the list missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of plans. It disappears when the set is unclear and the drafter sorts prints. Copying and tracing stay, so the net stays modest.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A dimension compare and a weight from a density can be prepared. The drafter still checks the exception, still reads a symbol, and still traces or copies by hand.
reach: Civil engineers own a stress conclusion, and this job learns a computed weight is not that conclusion.
Surveying and mapping technicians set the symbols, and this job learns identifying them is still a reading.
skills_to_grow: Stop a dimension check when the model has no dimension to compare.
Treat a copied sheet as the drafter's work on the machine, not as a finished issue.
role.ambitious_version: A materials list can show a dimension that disagrees with the model the same day, and the symbol on a survey is still read by the drafter.
